items.title: Lou Marini interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 15, 2023
items.q: here comes Saturday Night Live and Peter Tosh and Mick Jagger and me playing the solo. It was me.

ctx.x: Yeah. I got to play with him a few times in the educational settings and I felt so good about putting him in front of school kids. Like he was a role model in many ways. I’m going to test your memory a little bit. If you go to Wikipedia, your Wikipedia page, it has a very lengthy list of recordings you’ve played on, and I think it ends like ten years ago. But do you remember — I’m going to ask you a couple of things. Do you remember 1981 Peter Tosh, “Wanted Dread or Alive”?

Yeah you know what’s funny about that is my wife and I were on vacation in St. John’s and we were going into Cruise Bay and we discovered this Surf Bar that played nothing but reggae and it was really a cool bar. And we were in there one night. We’d been in there a couple of times before, and this tune came on and the saxophone solo started, and I was singing along with the saxophone solo you know. And I thought why does this solo sound so familiar? I said, “Who is this?” And so we got the name — when we got back…
Oh that’s a good one. Okay.
